language_task: Put the yellow bell pepper into the bowl.
outcome_evidence: The robot approaches and closes its gripper around the yellow bell pepper (frames 49–84, wrist_cam), then lifts and carries it toward the bowl (frames 91–112, left_base_cam and right_base_cam). It releases the pepper into the bowl at frames 113–115 (wrist_cam). The pepper remains inside as the bowl settles and the gripper withdraws (frames 121–142, wrist_cam, left_base_cam and right_base_cam). No failed acquisition, harmful collision, or unrelated object disturbance is visible.
